nodes.characterization_summary: STEM characterization showed that the NiO6 along the RP 2D faults would become amorphous much faster than the simple surface under anodic condition.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM) characterization showed that the NiO6 along the faults would become amorphous much faster than the simple surface under anodic condition.

nodes.characterization_summary: Co L-edge EELS and NEX-AFS demonstrated surface reconstruction to edge-sharing layered CoO2 species in SrCoO3.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Meanwhile, the Co L-edge electron energy loss spectroscopy (EELS) and surface sensitive near edge X-ray absorption fine structure (NEX-AFS) characterizations demonstrated that the surface remained Co and O atoms were reconstructed to form edge-sharing layered CoO2 species.

nodes.characterization_summary: XAS measurement indicated the formation of Co oxyhydroxide species at potentials higher than 1.6 V.
nodes.evidence_snippet: XAS measurement indicated the formation of Co oxyhydroxide species at potentials higher than 1.6 V, while no valence variation of Co was detected when potential was set at 1.5 V for 7 h.

nodes.characterization_summary: Operando XAS revealed that NiS2 would be preoxidized into Ni(OH)2, and then to NiOOH during electro-oxidation, fully converted within eight hours.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In our previous work, Operando XAS was conducted to study the phase transition of NiS2 under current density of 10 mA cm-2. It was revealed that the NiS2 would be preoxidized into Ni(OH)2, and then to NiOOH during the electro-oxidation.

nodes.characterization_summary: Operando XAS revealed that both NiSe2 and NiS2 would undergo phase transition from NiSe2/NiS2 to Ni(OH)2, and then to NiOOH.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In our previous works, we studied the structural reconstruction of NiS2 and NiSe2 via operando XAS under chronopotentiometry treatment at a fixed current of 10 mA cm-2. It was revealed that both of them would undergo phase transition from NiS2/NiSe2 to Ni(OH)2, and then to NiOOH.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni K-edge and O K-edge XAS revealed NiO6 octahedron distortion and e_g* band broadening extent increasing from Ni(OH)2 > Ni5P4-Ni(OH)2 > NiSe2-Ni(OH)2 > NiS2-Ni(OH)2.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Ni K-edge spectra were quite similar for these samples, with only mismatches on the white line region... FT-EXAFS results showed shorter Ni-O bond distances... in O K-edge spectra, the peak located around 534.0 eV... became lower and broader.

nodes.characterization_summary: In situ ETEM observed strong structural oscillations in BSCF and surface-confined oscillations in SCO with water vapor and electron irradiation.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Shao-Horn et al. observed strong structural oscillations in Ba0.5Sr0.5Co0.8Fe0.2O3-δ (BSCF) via in situ ETEM with the presence of water vapor and electron irradiation... Similar structural oscillation was also observed in SrCoO3-δ (SCO).
